Treatment summary
Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck while turning left. Complaints
centered on neck and low back pain with associated muscle tightness and limited range of motion. The mechanism of
injruy is consistent with the reported symptoms. Over the course of fourteen visits, care consisted of spinal
mobilization, soft tissue therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Treatment followed a typical
progression, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms improved and the patient returned to daily activities. Physical
examination documetned paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical rotation, supporting a soft tissue strain
diagnosis. Neurological screening, including reflexes, sensation, and strength, was within normal limits. No prior
injury or treatment to the neck or low back is known to this provider. Billed services were reviewed and reflect single,
non-duplicated charges for each encounter. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise.
